connectors.name: web_search
connectors.purpose: Discover competitors, market language, customer voice, distribution channels, SEO opportunities, and public evidence.

connectors.name: website_scraper_or_crawler
connectors.purpose: Extract customer and competitor website content, metadata, links, CTAs, structured data, and page text.

connectors.name: browser_automation
connectors.purpose: Inspect JavaScript-rendered pages, forms, search results, competitor pages, screenshots, and dynamic content when simple extraction is insufficient.

connectors.name: structured_storage
connectors.purpose: Store extracted customer, competitor, lead, source, and report evidence for repeatable runs and comparisons.

connectors.name: report_export
connectors.purpose: Export client-ready outputs as Markdown, HTML, PDF, CSV, or dashboard views.

connectors.name: github
connectors.purpose: Read or write versioned module artifacts and Codex handoff packets when authorized.
